en:
Kokichi is right. The floorboard came loose
because someone <CLT=cltSTRONG>stomped on it<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But floorboards fit perfect. Gonta make sure
first time we go to empty room!

When we first saw the room, yes. But when
I looked again during the investigation...

One of the crosspieces supporting the
floorboards was <CLT=cltSTRONG>cut off<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

After examining the cut, I concluded
that it must have been done deliberately.

Someone? You mean the culprit, right? 
Why'd they do that?

What did the culprit stand to gain
by cutting the crosspiece?

<CLT=cltMIND>What did they stand to gain?
That's the question...

<CLT=cltMIND>To solve this case, I'll need to think
carefully about the crosspiece and floorboard.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko's body was at one end
of the loose floorboard...

<CLT=cltMIND>And the crosspiece that had been cut
was on the other end of the floorboard.

<CLT=cltMIND>The unsupported part was outside the cage,
so it could have been stomped on...

<CLT=cltMIND>Only one of the crosspieces was cut.
The other two were intact.

<CLT=cltMIND>One of them was right
under Tenko...

<CLT=cltMIND>And the other was in the center, right
about where the edge of the cage was.

<CLT=cltMIND>What was the culprit attempting to
achieve by stomping on the floorboard?
